description: A retrieval anchor: one phrasing of a situation that should surface its ProtocolInstruction. anchorText is vectorized by the in-cluster TEI (jina-embeddings-v5-text-small) so callers query with raw text via nearText.

properties.name: anchorText
properties.description: The situation phrasing. Stored RAW: TEI applies the model's "Document: " prefix server-side via --default-prompt, so callers must not prefix.

properties.name: answeredBy
properties.description: The protocol this anchor resolves to. Many anchors per instruction is expected and intended; the retrieval client dedupes by instruction id.
